procedure: Two separate AI contexts each read all 40 unlabelled packets and the frozen glossary, without resolver output, external source labels or each other's annotations. A third AI reader adjudicates and checks all documents.
independence_limit: Separate contexts share a model family. This is AI annotation, not two independent human judgements or an independently validated human gold set.

scope.included: All occurrences of proper names for organizations, people, locations, named products, works and events, plus lexicalized neologisms, blends and abbreviations visible in context.
scope.excluded: Ordinary compositional common nouns, dates, numbers and anonymous role titles. Do not create an exhaustive negative label for every ordinary token.
scope.link: Use a frozen entity ID only when the contextual referent is that exact entity. A geographic city is distinct from its government, a subsidiary from its parent, and an institution from its official.
scope.nil: The contextual referent is absent from the frozen glossary, irrespective of resolver retrieval. Non-organization names and neologisms are usually NIL in this organization glossary.
scope.ambiguous: The contextual referent cannot be determined sufficiently to choose an entity. Do not invent IDs or expand the glossary.
scope.non_mention: A tempting registered-alias substring that context clearly uses as an ordinary nonentity expression.
scope.spans: Python codepoint half-open offsets in the unmodified packet text. Core excludes attached particles and nominal derivational suffixes. Full span includes a semantically derived nominal expression and excludes particles.
scope.full_identity: SAME for the same referent, DISTINCT for a role or derived entity, JUXTAPOSED for a genuine coordinated composite.
scope.should_commit: True only for an unambiguous LINK of the core; DISTINCT full-surface semantics do not authorize substituting the whole expression.
scope.families: Do not infer new family labels from resolver output or alter the sealed partitions. Omit mention family_ids unless supported by the frozen glossary.

split_policy: Retain the original sealed preparation-smoke train/validation/test assignments. AI readers see all packets only to annotate them; no resolver tuning or performance evaluation is performed in this annotation task.
publication: Archive IDs, hashes, offsets, labels and provenance; exclude document text, mention surfaces and free-text notes. Original document IDs can contain source-header words. Full packets remain in the ignored local corpus directory.
